mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id

SELECT ranked.queue_id, ranked.appointment_id, ranked.doctor_id, ranked.doctor_name, ranked.patient_id, ranked.patient_name, ranked.queue_no, ranked.position, ranked.status, ranked.visit_date, ranked.time_period, ranked.sign_in_time FROM ( SELECT q.id AS queue_id, a.id AS appointment_id, d.id AS doctor_id, d.name AS doctor_name, p.id AS patient_id, p.name AS patient_name, q.queue_no, CASE WHEN q.status = '等待接诊' THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY d.id, s.visit_date, s.time_period, q.status ORDER BY q.sort_no ASC, q.sign_time ASC, q.id ASC ) ELSE NULL END AS position, q.status, s.visit_date, s.time_period, q.sign_time AS sign_in_time FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id INNER JOIN doctor d ON d.id = a.doctor_id INNER JOIN patient p ON p.id = a.patient_id ) ranked
ORDER BY ranked.visit_date DESC, ranked.doctor_id ASC, ranked.time_period ASC, ranked.position ASC, ranked.queue_id ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT q.id AS queue_id, a.doctor_id, s.visit_date, s.time_period, q.status, q.sort_no FROM queue q INNER JOIN appointment a ON a.id = q.appointment_id INNER JOIN source s ON s.id = a.source_id WHERE q.id = #{queueId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO operation_log ( operator_id, operation_type, action, target_type, target_id, target, reason, result ) VALUES ( #{adminId}, 'QUEUE_ADJUST', 'REORDER', 'QUEUE', #{queueId}, LEFT(CONCAT('队列ID=', #{queueId}, '，原位置=', #{oldPosition}, '，新位置=', #{newPosition}), 100), #{reason}, '成功' )
